title.zh: 一张图看懂能带、导带与价带
title.en: Energy, conduction and valence bands at a glance

subtitle.zh: 从原子能级、费米能级到掺杂与能带弯曲
subtitle.en: From atomic/Fermi levels to doping and band bending

body.zh: 原子靠近后，离散能级分裂并汇聚成允许能带。能量E向上；孤立原子离散能级 → 多原子靠近、能级分裂 → 大量能级聚集形成导带、价带，两者之间为带隙E_g。
body.en: As atoms approach, discrete levels split and collect into allowed bands. Energy E increases upward. Isolated atomic levels → splitting as atoms approach → many closely spaced levels form conduction/valence bands separated by E_g.

body.zh: 两类允许能带承担不同成键与输运角色。导带E_c为电子输运能带，价带E_v为原子成键能带；橙色表示负电电子，空心圆表示正电空穴。
body.en: The two allowed bands serve different bonding/transport roles. E_c marks the conduction band for electrons; E_v marks the valence band associated with bonding. Orange denotes negatively charged electrons; hollow circles denote positive holes.

body.zh: 带隙描述允许态间隔，费米能级E_F描述占据倾向。费米–狄拉克分布：f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]；图中E=E_F处电子占据概率为0.5。
body.en: The gap describes separation between allowed states; E_F describes occupation tendency. Fermi–Dirac distribution: f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]; occupation is 0.5 at E=E_F.

body.zh: 电子受光/热激发至导带（图示能量≥E_g），价带留下空穴；图示电子传导、空穴传导以及复合发光/放热。
body.en: Optical/thermal excitation moves electrons to the conduction band (energy ≥E_g illustrated), leaving holes. The diagram shows electron/hole conduction and recombination releasing light/heat.

body.zh: 原图以金属价带/导带重叠、无带隙，半导体带隙较小可热激发载流子，绝缘体带隙很大、载流子极少作示意；三者差异不只带隙大小。
body.en: The source schematically shows metal bands overlapping with no gap, a smaller semiconductor gap allowing thermal carriers, and a large insulator gap with very few carriers. Their differences are not only gap size.

body.zh: 本征半导体E_F在带隙中部附近，电子和空穴浓度相等。n型施主能级E_D近导带，E_F上移、电子为多数；p型受主能级E_A近价带，E_F下移、空穴为多数。
body.en: Intrinsic E_F lies near midgap with equal electron/hole concentrations. N-type donor E_D lies near the conduction band, raising E_F with electrons majority. P-type acceptor E_A lies near valence, lowering E_F with holes majority.

body.zh: 空间电势变化使E_c、E_v随位置移动。热平衡PN结图标p型、耗尽层、n型，E_c/E_v跨结弯曲而E_F平坦。
body.en: Spatial potential shifts E_c/E_v with position. The equilibrium PN junction shows p-region, depletion and n-region; band edges bend while E_F remains flat.

body.zh: 按器件目标选材料、掺杂和界面势垒。原图举宽带隙用于高耐压/高温、中等带隙用于通用器件、窄带隙用于高速/光电；n型提高电子浓度，p型提高空穴浓度，本征/轻掺杂平衡特性；选择合适金属—半导体势垒高度φ_B以降低接触电阻、改善性能。
body.en: Select material, doping and interface barrier for device goals. Source examples associate wide gaps with high voltage/temperature, medium gaps with general devices and narrow gaps with high speed/optoelectronics. N/P doping raises electron/hole concentration; intrinsic/light doping balances properties. Choose a suitable metal–semiconductor barrier φ_B to reduce contact resistance and improve performance.
